Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm copper-gold bronze metal across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID turquoise-green verdigris patina gathering in every recess and joint, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, satin-polished raised edges, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. #1: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same bronze with a high polish.
#1: Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

#2: a warm bronze-brown complexion, mid 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, half-up half-down chocolate brown hair — full body glazed ox-blood red porcelain fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glazed porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep ox-blood copper-red glaze across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale streaks and fine golden crackle lines running between the sections, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Environment: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a standard-height doorway, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as any of them.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. CRITICAL: all 2 women's legs must show FULL BODY ART coverage from hip to ankle to toe with NO bare untattooed skin visible anywhere, every element standing in true relief, nothing flat. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
